newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread sells 13 hotels to Regal.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread sells 13 hotels to Regal.

text.p: Brewer-to-leisure group Whitbread Plc said on Friday that it has conditionally agreed to sell 13 hotels to Regal Hotel Group Plc for 64.5 million stg.
It said in a statement that the sale of the 13 three star hotels was part of the company's strategy of focusing specifically on the four star and budget hotel markets.

"The effect of their sale will be marginally dilutive for Whitbread but this is more than outweighed by the benefit of enabling our hotel management team to concentrate on developing further the Marriott and Travel Inn brands," said chief executive designate David Thomas.
